page_title: RSO 0-1 CEL | Real Sociedad v Celta Vigo 13/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) was probably a bit loose with his words to Victor Garcia, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+4' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement. Real Sociedad have been awarded a free kick.
90+1' Substitution. Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fran Beltran walks off.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
87' A yellow card for a tackle by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad). Victor Garcia doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) fails to turn the rebound in from a promising position. The goalkeeper pulls off a superb save and denies his effort.
87' The manager makes a subsitution with Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) coming on for Mikel Oyarzabal.
86' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is caught offside!
86' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) whips in a cross from the corner, but Vicente Guaita is well positioned and punches the ball away.
86' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Real Sociedad earn a corner.
85' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
85' There's a break in play and referee Victor Garcia must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Sociedad using VAR. This could be interesting!
85' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

84' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
83' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

83' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
82' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Victor Garcia saw the whole situation.
82' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Vicente Guaita makes a comfortable save.
81' The linesman signals that Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
79' Flag goes up against Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Aihen Munoz.
77' Here's the change. Brais Mendez leaves the pitch and Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
77' Substitution. Iker Losada (Celta Vigo) has come on for Borja Iglesias.
77' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Alfonso Gonzalez and he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
77' A substitution has been made. Mihailo Ristic goes off and Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) comes on.
76' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
74' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
73' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
72' The attendance is 25124.
71' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) for a tough tackle.

70' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed under the crossbar, Vicente Guaita didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough. Real Sociedad win a corner.
68' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
66' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fernando Lopez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
66' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
63' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) is booked.
63' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Substitution. Sergio Gomez walks off the pitch and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
61' Here is a change. Hamari Traore is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad).
59' A pass into the box finds Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Vicente Guaita denies him.
57' CHANCE! Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
57' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but it's cleared.
53' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
53' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
53' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Real Sociedad get a free kick.

51' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Real Sociedad.
49' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) gets to the ball inside the box, sees the goalkeeper off his line and lifts the ball over him and into the back of the net. 0:1.
44' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alex Remiro.
43' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is flagged for offside.
43' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
41' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
40' Victor Garcia blows his whistle. Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after dangerous play. Celta Vigo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
40' It looks like Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) saw red with that tackle. Victor Garcia won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
37' The corner from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is hurriedly cleared.
37' That looked a certain handball by Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
37' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
35' The game is interrupted as Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is flagged offside.
33' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) finds space near the penalty spot to plant a header at goal from the corner, but it's badly directed and drifts well wide of the right post.
33' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
30' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.

29' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Real Sociedad are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
26' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
23' Victor Garcia couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Celta Vigo.
22' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece. A free kick is awarded to Celta Vigo.
21' The resulting corner, taken by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad), comes to nothing.
20' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.

17' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
15' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
12' There's an opportunity for Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

11' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.
8' The players claim that Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
3' What a huge chance for Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
2' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
1' Victor Garcia blows for a foul after Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia is the one to supervise the game today.
